ctx-scaffolder.description: Adds ctx agent context to a new or existing project with the ctx CLI (ctx new / ctx scaffold), then fills TODO markers from repo metadata. Give it the target directory and, optionally, a preset name.

ctx-standards.description: Read-only audit of a repo against its own ctx standards (AGENTS.md hard rules, .context guides, in-flight docs). Reports violations with path:line; never edits.

ctx-writer.description: Writes one ctx doc draft (brief, design, or spec) following the repo's own .context/guides and doc lifecycle. Give it the doc kind, the topic, and the source doc for a design or spec.
